creators.name: MIKITYPE
creators.introduction: MIKITYPE是一位日本的书法艺术家。1992年在札幌出生，2015年毕业于武藏野美术大学艺术情报学科。大学期间他从师于书法大家三戸 美奈子学习书法艺术。他曾为Sacai AW 2016巴黎时装周、 Men's N.Hoolywood SS 2016纽约时装周、Vans、 United Arrows、自由が丘Maison Iéna、2015TV东京世乒赛 、三代目 J Soul Brothers巡回演出以及The Pool Aoyama Fragment Design x N.Hoolywood等国内外杂志做过编辑工作。

creators.name: 索尼中国
creators.introduction: 索尼中国

creators.name: HI(NY)
creators.introduction: HI(NY) is a boutique design studio founded by Hitomi Watanabe Deluca and Iku Oyamada, with offices in New York and Kyoto. Their work focuses on branding and identity for clients including Coca-Cola, MTV, the United Nations and Isetan; multiple ONE SHOW and GDUSA awards.

creators.name: 伊勢 尚生
creators.introduction: Ise Naoki (伊勢尚生, b. 1986 in Aomori) is a Japanese graphic designer at Yamaguchi Center for Arts and Media (YCAM). He studied information design at Tama Art University and Berlin University of the Arts; his work spans media-art exhibition graphics for ICC and YCAM. Selected as an official creator for Sony's FES Watch U Creative Festival 2018.

creators.name: enamel.
creators.introduction: enamel.是由石岡良治和石岡紗佑里组成的设计小组。石岡良治师从伊藤桂司先生，于2001年独立，并与石岡紗佑里共同致力于时尚、家居方面的原创作品设计以及相关艺术监制、图像设计、织物等的设计和印刷工作。另外，我们还展开了从构建、编码到包装设计的网页制作业务。并于2006年在网店marimekko初开张时担任了艺术监制、图像和包装设计。自2013年起在京都精華大学流行文化学院担任非常勤讲师。

creators.name: YOSHIROTTEN
creators.introduction: Yoshirotten是东京的图像设计师以及艺术设计师。他拥有大量海内外客户，为许多品牌、音乐人和企业提供设计以及相关产品制作。2013年出版了作品集「GASBOOK 28 YOSHIROTTEN」，在2014-15的梅赛德斯奔驰东京时尚周担任关键视觉效果监制，并在柏林、伦敦也有作品发表。

creators.name: FDMTL
creators.introduction: FDMTL以“越穿越爱”为理念，是享誉世界的牛仔布、牛仔服饰品牌。一直采用纯手工制作，对于细节决不妥协的精神保证每一件FDMTL的制品都不是那些大型工厂流水线下生产的服饰所能比拟的。

creators.name: Tomoaki Ryu / mifrel Designer
creators.introduction: Graphic Design Work for different Clients such as Shift, Dazed&Confused, BBC Radio1, Victionaries, AllRightsReserved etc. Had exhibitions at Tokyo, New York, Frankfurt, Hong Kong Taiwan etc. Started Textile Fashion Label called mifrel since 2007 till now. Open Shop at 2015, Gallery&Space at 2016. Currently http://www.mifrel.co.jp is under construction. We,ll be ready for website as soon as possible. If any work require please contact to https://www.instagram.com/__mifrel__/  or tomoakiryu@outlook.jp

creators.name: Bouillon
creators.introduction: Bouillon is a product and interior design studio founded by Shunya Hattori and Hiroki Nasu, splitting its work between Nagoya and Tokyo. Recognised at Salone Satellite, Stockholm Furniture Fair, Milan Design Week and Toyama Design Competition.

creators.name: Superman
creators.introduction: Superman

creators.name: AHONEN & LAMBARG
creators.introduction: Ahonen & Lamberg is a Paris-based multidisciplinary design studio founded by Anna Ahonen and Katariina Lamberg. They work across art direction, editorial and identity design for fashion and culture clients.

creators.name: Ohri Ogi
creators.introduction: 1988年出生于东京。先在荷兰埃因霍恩设计学院（Design Academy Eindhoven）学习后，又在里特维尔德艺术学院（Gerrit Rietveld Academy）继续深造，主修图像设计。毕业归国后作为一名图像设计师活跃于业界。

creators.name: Yu Nagaba
creators.introduction: 1976年出生于东京，毕业于东京造形大学。捕捉人物特征的简笔线画的设计风格为服饰品牌、广告、书籍、包装等提供设计。 每日在Instagram(@kaerusensei)上传一个作品。他的主要工作还有为杂志“POPEYE”设计封面插画以及为“Tokyo Metro”设计文明海报等。

creators.name: Tangent
creators.introduction: Tangent is a UK design studio that contributed to Sony's FES Watch U launch lineup. Their original site has since been retired.

creators.name: SAP SQA
creators.introduction: This account is for SAP SQA

creators.name: Yusaku Kanda
creators.introduction: Kanda Yusaku (神田有作) is a Japanese designer selected as an official creator for Sony's FES Watch U Creative Festival 2018, where 32 creators were chosen on the theme of 'diversity'.

creators.name: akutsu-do
creators.introduction: Akutsu Kanako (あくつかなこ) is a Japanese illustrator selected as an official creator for Sony's FES Watch U Creative Festival 2018.

creators.name: YOY
creators.introduction: YOY is a Tokyo design studio founded in 2011 by spatial designer Naoki Ono and product designer Yuki Yamamoto. Working under the theme 'between space and object', they create furniture, lighting and installations exhibited at Milan Design Week since 2012.

creators.name: Hamanaka Nozomi
creators.introduction: Hamanaka Nozomi (濱中望実) is a Japanese designer selected as an official creator for Sony's FES Watch U Creative Festival 2018.

creators.name: TAKASE HANANO
creators.introduction: Takase Hanano (たかせはなの) is a Japanese illustrator selected as an official creator for Sony's FES Watch U Creative Festival 2018.

creators.name: Ken Kagami
creators.introduction: 现代美术作家。1974年出生于东京。参加过许多国内外美术展，善于将日常之事用幽默的表现力来创作美术作品。近期作品故意使用一些在美术创作中常用的素材，致力于使用废弃物及通常被认为不能成为美术主题的材料等打造出在美术史上被提及的系列青铜工艺品。2010年在东京代官山开设了销售他自己周边商品以及二手服饰的零售店。

creators.name: 梁子豪
creators.introduction: 我正在香港知專設計學院修讀時裝媒體設計文憑。平日對攝影及潮流趨勢感興趣，我相信自己的設計能應用於日常生活上。我個人的座右銘是 「時間可以改變一切，每個人能創造屬於自己的故事。」

creators.name: Tatsuro HORIKAWA / JULIUS
creators.introduction: 于1996年成立平面设计公司Third Stone。经过长期以来作为平面设计师的经验、于2001年开创品牌“JULIUS”。以服装、映像、图像和音乐为轴心继续自己独有的暗黑、工业化、哥特式风格的创作。于2015年发表了街装品牌“NILøS”。并与许多前卫音乐人合作发表了诸多音乐作品。

creators.name: Fashion Entertainments
creators.introduction: Fashion Entertainments is Sony's in-house startup behind the FES Watch U. They use electronic paper as a fabric so a single watch can carry endless face and strap designs. The first FES Watch U launched on Sony's First Flight crowdfunding platform in 2017, co-designed with Tokyo studio TAKT PROJECT.

creators.name: Tsuguya Inoue
creators.introduction: 1947年出生于宫崎县。1978年创建了Beans。曾担任Parco、Suntory、 COMME des GARCONS、朝日新闻社、出版、音乐、TV等的广告和艺术指导，完成过写真集制作、广告艺术监制以及日本职业棒球机构的象征标志“NPB”的制作等。曾参与并荣获过许多奖项，包括东京ADC最高奖、东京ADC会员奖、东京ADC大奖赛、东京TDC大奖赛、东京TDC会员奖、东京TDC图书设计奖、日本宣传山名奖。是东京ADC会员、东京TDC会员以及JAGDA会员。

creators.name: Tokyo Calendar
creators.introduction: Tokyo Calendar is a lifestyle media having been published as a monthly magazine since 2001, now expanding to a website and an application. It brings real and stimulating lifestyle contents to mature urban dwellers, adding color to their life with popular serial novels and essays or latest prime restaurant lists.

creators.name: ten_do_ten
creators.introduction: ten_do_ten is a Japanese pixel artist who studied under Gento Matsumoto at Musashino Art University. The name reads 'ten by ten' — ten meaning both dot and pixel in Japanese. Active since launching the ten_do site in 2001, working across visual art, sound and exhibitions.

creators.name: YOON
creators.introduction: Tokyo Monochrome

creators.name: DJ DARUMA / FULL-BK
creators.introduction: 一个拥有HIP HOP灵魂的，自由运用各种声音让舞池为之疯狂的DJ。2014年1月1日他作为DJ/制片人与LDH闪电签约，和艺人EXILE HIRO、DJ MAKIDAI、VERBAL一起开始了名为“PKCZ®”的项目。另外，他还为高端街装潮牌“FULL-BK”提供设计提案。是一位非常令人瞩目的DJ。

creators.name: Mayumi Ishida
creators.introduction: Ishida Mayumi (石田真弓) is a Tokyo-based artist working across painting, installation and musical composition. She has synesthesia and treats sound as visual material. Selected as an official creator for Sony's FES Watch U Creative Festival 2018.

creators.name: Yuki Tomigahara
creators.introduction: Tomigahara Yuki (冨ヶ原由季) is a Japanese illustrator selected as an official creator for Sony's FES Watch U Creative Festival 2018.

creators.name: NOSIGNER
creators.introduction: NOSIGNER是以优化社会与未来为理想的设计公司。希望可以成为发现问题并做出为社会所需的、完美关联性设计的团队。“无形事物设计人”是“NOSIGNER”这个名字的意义所在。公司业务除了在图像、产品以及空间等设计领域的工作以外，还包括商业模型的构筑、品牌包装等综合性的设计服务。另外，公司开创了以“OLIVE PROJECT”为首的，有用于灾害时的开放式共享设计资源；以及在当地产业、科学技术、教育、持续性、文化交流等领域积极地做出对社会有意义的革新。

creators.name: TOWA TEI
creators.introduction: 1990年作为“Deee-Lite”的成员之一，以在美国发表的专辑《WorldClique》正式出道。之后以日本为主要活动中心，于1994年发布了首张个人专辑《Future Listening!》正式单飞。自此之后以个人创作者身份不断创作他自己的音乐，并于2014年在其单飞后的第20周年之际发行了《94-14 REMIX》、《94-14 COVERS》和《94-14》三部精选专辑。之后与高橋幸宏、小山田圭吾、砂原良徳、LEO今井组合，以“METAFIVE”为名正式展开活动并发表了两张专辑。他们的全国巡回演出也大获成功。  自2013年9月到现在，一直担任位于东京青山的INTERSECT BY LEXUS - TOKYO的店内音乐监修。2017年担任日本NHK综艺节目“草間彌生 我永恒的灵魂”的音乐总监，并发布了第9张个人原创专辑《EMO》。

creators.name: O l g a
creators.introduction: Olga is the designer behind Etw.Vonneguet, a Tokyo-based fashion-tech label. After studying fashion and technology in the UK, she works across digital collections, conductive textiles and 3DCG runway formats. Selected as an official creator for Sony's FES Watch U Creative Festival.

creators.name: Hunger Magazine
creators.introduction: Each other is a contemporary Paris based fashion brand that promotes its sensual architectural wardrobe for women. Born of an encounter between the two founders and creative directors - fashion designer Ilan Delouis and art director & gallerist Jenny Mannerheim. Their complementary universes and visions fuse roughness and sensuality, timeless pieces and experimental design. The style of Each Other encompasses the founders passion for the architecture of John Lautner, the minimalism art movement associated with sculptures by Donald Judd and light artworks by Dan Flavin. Focusing on tailoring, the timeless ‘vestiaire’ and noble fabrics, the brand reinterprets statement wardrobe pieces that are re-sculpted and composed into a singular feminine silhouette. The brand also acts as a label and media for artists and creative talents to collaborate on limited edition fashion items that keep up the pulse of the collections through the seasons.  Hunger Magazine is a fast evolving and expanding biannual lifestyle, fashion, music and art magazine from photographer and publisher, Rankin. Constantly widening its reach, the magazine is continuing to collaborate with the best of photographers, stylists and creative minds and have an extensive and active social media network to engage and interact with its readers. However, the publication remains the same at its core: fascinated by people, fashion, music and art.

creators.name: Batman
creators.introduction: Batman

creators.name: Syun Yanagisawa
creators.introduction: Yanagisawa Shun (柳澤駿) is a Tokyo art director and graphic designer working across branding, visual identity and editorial. Selected as an official creator for Sony's FES Watch U Creative Festival 2018.

creators.name: Asaoka Maria
creators.introduction: Asaoka Maria (あさおかまりあ), based in Shizuoka, is an illustrator working in the yuru-kyara style of soft, friendly Japanese characters. She illustrated The Musubi Book. Selected as an official creator for Sony's FES Watch U Creative Festival 2018.

creators.name: Madblast Hiro
creators.introduction: Madblast Hiro is a Japanese painter working across mural, live painting and canvas, with exhibitions including Gallery White Cube. Selected as an official creator for Sony's FES Watch U Creative Festival.

creators.name: All The Fruits
creators.introduction: All The Fruits是由平面设计师Stephen Cheetham和室内设计师Jessica Pinotti于2013年在伦敦创立的多方位创作设计工作室，现在主要以意大利博洛尼亚为工作中心展开业务活动。二人在成功完成了几次合作项目后，感觉到了彼此能力组合的可能性，因而成立了该工作室。主要在家居、建筑、家具和时尚等领域的设计上备受瞩目。

creators.name: Mashikaku
creators.introduction:
自2000年代前半开始，作为图形设计师、艺术总监，参与了多项广告设计、网页以及产品设计等工作。并于2010年代后半起与艺术家山口真人以及因设计“绝影字体”而著名的书体设计师加納佳之一起组成了艺术创作团队。
创作以2人开发的汉字书体“真四角”为基础，向世界传着正方形强烈的视觉美以及作为日本人对日本元素的致追求的艺术作品。

creators.name: Tatsunoko Production
creators.introduction: Tatsunoko Production

creators.name: TAKT PROJECT
creators.introduction: TAKT PROJECT is a Tokyo design studio that runs both client work and self-driven research, with a Tohoku Lab in Sendai. Co-designed Sony's original FES Watch U. Their stated mission is to 'destabilize existing frameworks to cultivate the future.'

creators.name: we+
creators.introduction: we+ is a Tokyo contemporary design studio founded in 2013 by Toshiya Hayashi and Hokuto Ando. Their research-based practice explores 'alternative design that establishes a close coexistence with the natural and social environment.'

creators.name: Atsuo Ogawa
creators.introduction: Ogawa Atsuo (小川敦生) is a Japanese fine artist represented by Base Gallery, selected as an official creator for Sony's FES Watch U Creative Festival 2018.

creators.name: nakayama kei
creators.introduction: Nakayama Kei (中山桂) works at RD-MAK, a market-development product design office in Shibuya, Tokyo, founded in 1974. Selected as an official creator for Sony's FES Watch U Creative Festival 2018.

creators.name: 伊咲乃 玲名
creators.introduction: Isakino Reina (伊咲乃玲名) is a Japanese visual artist selected as an official creator for Sony's FES Watch U Creative Festival 2018. Active on Instagram as @123chura.

creators.name: Takumi Hasegawa
creators.introduction: Takumi Hasegawa is a Tokyo-based creative front-end developer working under the unshift studio name, with a design-forward approach to interactive web work.

creators.name: B&A
creators.introduction: B&A is an international artist representation agency with offices in New York, London, Berlin and Los Angeles. Their roster spans photographers, illustrators, animators, CGI studios and mural artists working for global brands.

creators.name: Takuya Suga
creators.introduction: Suga Takuya (管拓也) is a Japanese book jacket and graphic designer, selected as an official creator for Sony's FES Watch U Creative Festival 2018.

creators.name: StudioKanna
creators.introduction: StudioKanna是一个平面设计工作室，专精于企业形象设计和印刷物设计。Kanna于1995年远渡英国，在伦敦的中央圣马丁艺术与设计学院（ Central Saint Martins College of Art & Design）获得了平面设计学士学位。起先她作为编辑设计师为英式杂志“Dazed and Confused”工作，之后又加入了以企业形象设计而闻名的设计公司North。她于2006年返回日本并创立了自己的设计工作室。自此，凭借在英国培养的品牌创意为设计基础，不断追求不受既存概念限制的，简单而又有意义的表达方式。除此以外，她还同有相同创作精神的伙伴们一起积极地组织、企划各种展览，以及为地域活性化做贡献的各种活动。现在，主要以日本和欧洲为活动中心，把伦敦的基础与在东京的经验结合起来，探寻更趋精益的个性。

creators.name: Calligrapher MAMI
creators.introduction: “Calligraf2ity”是书法教室黑美会把HIP HOP文化之一的涂鸦与日本书法相结合创造出的新类型视觉艺术品牌。 Calligraphy + Graffiti = Calligraf2ity 该命名中“2”的意义包括以下两重含义： 1.把数字“1、2、3、4……”读作“Hi、 fu、 mi、 yo……”的日本训读文化。 2.日本书法 (Calligraphy) 与涂鸦 (Graffiti)两种文化相融合的次世代传统。

creators.name: gorillaSTAR
creators.introduction: gorillaSTAR is a Japanese designer working across character design, 3D modelling and motion graphics. Their festival design 'yellowAMIKO' was selected for Sony's FES Watch U Creative Festival.

creators.name: Deanne Cheuk
creators.introduction: Deanne Cheuk一位纽约的艺术总监、插画家和艺术家。Cheuk的作品灵感来源于自然、乌托邦、空间与人类，常将现实表现扭曲成幻想。她的商业客户包括Converse、Nike、Levi’s、 Uniqlo、 American Express和Dell等。

creators.name: MK studio
creators.introduction: MK studio is a Japanese design studio selected as one of 32 official creators for Sony's FES Watch U Creative Festival 2018.

creators.name: a-tan-pic
creators.introduction: a-tan-pic is a Tokyo illustrator and character designer working primarily in Adobe Illustrator on goods and sticker projects. Selected as an official creator for Sony's FES Watch U Creative Festival.

creators.name: iLovedust
creators.introduction: iLovedust is a UK design crüe working under the motto 'Seduction vs. Function' — graphic design, illustration and art direction with a punk edge. Their clients include Nike, Levi's and the New York Times.

creators.name: Mika Horsburgh
creators.introduction: I'm a web designer from Shonan area in Japan. I have started my own business from 2011 specialize in web design, coding, growth hacking. I'm also interested in product design.

creators.name: MARVEL
creators.introduction:
75年以上の歴史を持ち、数々のスーパーヒーローと彼らが活躍する作品を世に送り出している、マーベル。
スパイダーマンを始め、アイアンマン、X-MENなど8,000以上ものキャラクターを擁し、その数は現在も増え続けている。
現実世界を題材とするマーベルには、ヒーロー同志の共演も多い。全世界で映画史を塗り替える大ヒットを記録した「アベンジャーズ」などはその代表。

creators.name: Ed TSUWAKI
creators.introduction: 艺术家，1966年出生于广岛，在幼少年期通过自学习得了绘画和设计。80年代后期开始在东京展开活动。他的时尚插画展以独特的女性描绘形式被评入日本美人画谱系，在国内外享有很高的评价。他作品被应用于多国的“VOGUE ”、“Wallpaper*”等的时尚杂志、品牌、广告、夹克等。从2000年原创服饰品牌“nakEd bunch”上市，作为设计师一直到2010年休止为止。 自最初的个展“Ed-ten ('94)”开始，近年来他不断地举办了许多不同主题的展览会，例如：“DESSERT HOUSE”、“CoCo”、“Panspermia”等。2015年出版了自己的首部抽象绘画作品集“QUAKENESS”，同名项目至今仍在进行中。2017年春举办了自己的首次名为“Salt Honey”的陶艺作品展。

creators.name: KAMI
creators.introduction:
设计师KAMI作为艺术团体“BARNSTORMERS”的原始成员之一于1999年开启了他的职业艺术生涯。他将街头文化元素与家乡京都的传统风情融合在一起，创建出他自己独特的设计风格。另外，还与搭档SASU一起以“HITOTZUKI”为名在世界各国不断地进行壁画创作，通过壁画给人们的生活带来色彩。
instagram : @kami_htzk

creators.introduction: TOYO KEIZAI ONLINE

creators.name: GASIUS
creators.introduction: Gasius is the work of London-based illustrator and skater Russell Maurice, known for surreal, hand-drawn characters that move between zines, streetwear, and gallery walls.

creators.name: Bob Foundation
creators.introduction: Bob Foundation is a Tokyo creative studio active since 2002, working across art direction, graphic and product design, exhibitions and illustration. They run the lifestyle brand DAILY BOB.

creators.name: N&R FOLDINGS
creators.introduction: N&R Foldings is a Japanese product design studio focused on folding-based forms. Their original lines include ORISHIKI and Poligon alongside collaborations with brands and institutions.

creators.name: PAPIER TIGRE
creators.introduction: PAPIER TIGRE是法国著名文具品牌，于2011年诞生于巴黎马莱区。通过色彩、图案的组合搭配，大胆的创意和现代风格的装饰，使人们日常生活更加美好。设计创作涉及文具、收纳、游戏、墙纸甚至仙人掌等各方面。

creators.name: YASUDA RINO

creators.name: HOMEWORK
creators.introduction: HOMEWORK是位于丹麦哥本哈根的国际知名图像设计工作室及创意顾问。以经典艺术和现代艺术完美融合的设计作风，唤醒人们对更好生活的向往。工作室与许多国内外世界级大品牌建立了长期的信赖、合作关系，在美妆、时尚、家庭用品等领域做过品牌企划、CI、艺术监制和品牌更新的业务。

creators.name: FORZA STYLE
creators.introduction: 『FORZA STYLE（フォルツァスタイル）』は、最速で本質に迫るファッション＆ライフスタイルのウェブマガジン。『LEON』や『OCEANS』をヒットさせたファッションディレクター干場義雅が編集長を務め、アニキこと片野英児氏や、日本アパレル業界の大御所、赤峰幸生氏などが暴れまくる、講談社の新感覚ウェブメディアです。

creators.name: Hunger Magazine
creators.introduction: Each other is a contemporary Paris based fashion brand that promotes its sensual architectural wardrobe for women. Born of an encounter between the two founders and creative directors - fashion designer Ilan Delouis and art director & gallerist Jenny Mannerheim. Their complementary universes and visions fuse roughness and sensuality, timeless pieces and experimental design. The style of Each Other encompasses the founders passion for the architecture of John Lautner, the minimalism art movement associated with sculptures by Donald Judd and light artworks by Dan Flavin. Focusing on tailoring, the timeless ‘vestiaire’ and noble fabrics, the brand reinterprets statement wardrobe pieces that are re-sculpted and composed into a singular feminine silhouette. The brand also acts as a label and media for artists and creative talents to collaborate on limited edition fashion items that keep up the pulse of the collections through the seasons.  Hunger Magazine is a fast evolving and expanding biannual lifestyle, fashion, music and art magazine from photographer and publisher, Rankin. Constantly widening its reach, the magazine is continuing to collaborate with the best of photographers, stylists and creative minds and have an extensive and active social media network to engage and interact with its readers. However, the publication remains the same at its core: fascinated by people, fashion, music and art.

creators.name: New Balance
creators.introduction: New Balance, headquartered in Boston, MA has the following mission: Demonstrating responsible leadership, we build global brands that athletes are proud to wear, associates are proud to create and communities are proud to host. In 1906 we started as a manufacturer of arch support and now become a global athletic brand with a full range of footwear and apparels over sports categories such as running, tennis, baseball, and football.

creators.name: EVANGELION
creators.introduction: 「エヴァンゲリオン」は、世界的に人気のアニメーションシリーズです。1995年のTVシリーズ「新世紀エヴァンゲリオン」の放送から始まり、コミック・映画・ゲームなどさまざまなメディアに展開、社会現象を巻き起こしました。2007年から始まった「ヱヴァンゲリヲン新劇場版」シリーズは、魅力的なキャラクター造形や、奥深いストーリーやドラマによって、若者を中心に幅広い年代の男女に受け入れられました。斬新かつスタイリッシュな映像表現は一般の視聴者だけでなく、国内外問わず多数のクリエーターに影響を与えています。2020年には「シン・エヴァンゲリオン劇場版」が公開の予定です。

creators.name: SEIYA-TOKYO (SEIYA FUJIKURA)
creators.introduction: SEIYA-TOKYO is a comprehensive art project by Seiya Fujikura spanning illustration, graphic design, apparel and music, with the SEIYA-TOKYO Records label and the trackmaker fashion brand.

creators.name: Marcus James
creators.introduction: Marcus James is a UK visual artist trained at the Royal College of Art. His large-scale pen-and-ink drawings, screenprints and sculptures examine glacial extinction and humanity's relationship with landscape — from the Aral Sea to the Pine Island Glacier.

creators.name: Kunihiko Morinaga / ANREALAGE Designer
creators.introduction: 设计师森永邦彦1980年出生于日本东京。毕业于早稻田大学社会科学系，在学期间他还在凡达设计学院（Vantan Design Academy）学习设计、更新二手服装的创作。2003年创立了品牌ANREALAGE，该品牌的意义源于A REAL-日常、UN REAL-非日常和AGE-時代。抓住日常生活中那些非现实的细节是他设计灵感的起源；把“神寄宿于细节”作为信念，擅长将服饰与科技相结合，设计的服装色彩鲜艳、细节讲究、不拘泥于人体结构，风格古怪独特。2005年获得纽约GEN ART的Avan-Garde大奖；2011年获资生堂时尚大奖新人奖。2014年、15年登上了巴黎时装周，并于2015年入围法国ANDAM 时尚大奖。2016年位于东京南青山的服装店ANREALAGE AOYAMA开张。
